summary: Niger's Foreign Ministry says all foreigners must present at the border a passport bearing a Nigerien visa, unless exempted by a bilateral or community agreement, and that the visa is in principle applied for at a Nigerien diplomatic or consular post where the applicant lives (exceptionally at the point of entry); it publishes no list of exempt nationalities. Niger's embassy in Turkey says a visa is mandatory to enter Niger except for nationals of the member states of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) and of certain states with which Niger has agreements abolishing short-stay visas. The UK, Canadian and Australian governments say their citizens need a visa; Canada says to obtain it before travel. The UK and Canadian governments advise against all travel to Niger.

tips.text: The UK and Canadian governments both advise against all travel to Niger.

Canada's travel advice says to avoid the regions bordering Mali and Burkina Faso, and the UK Foreign Office says banditry, smuggling and other criminal activity is common in border areas, particularly Maradi, Tillabéri and Diffa.

The UK Foreign Office says not to photograph military or government installations; Canada says photography of sensitive installations, including military sites and government buildings, is prohibited, says not to photograph political or student demonstrations or military personnel, and to always seek permission before photographing a person.
The UK Foreign Office says Niger is a cash-based society, credit cards are rarely accepted even in hotels and restaurants visited by international clients, and there are few ATMs.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Niger?
faq.answer: Niger's Foreign Ministry says all foreigners must present at the border a passport bearing a Nigerien visa unless a bilateral or community agreement exempts them; it publishes no list of exempt nationalities. The UK government says British nationals need a visa and can apply at the Nigerien embassy in Geneva, Canada says its citizens must obtain a visa before travel, and Australia says its citizens need a visa. Niger's embassy in Turkey says a visa is mandatory except for nationals of ECOWAS member states and of certain states with which Niger has agreements abolishing short-stay visas, and that the visa exemption agreement between Turkey and Niger covers holders of diplomatic, service and special passports. No official source we could read names the other states with such agreements.

faq.question: Is it safe to travel to Niger right now?
faq.answer: The UK and Canadian governments both advise against all travel to Niger; Canada cites political instability and the risks of terrorism and kidnapping.

faq.question: Did Niger's exit from ECOWAS end visa-free travel for West Africans?
faq.answer: The ECOWAS Commission says the citizens of Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger continue to enjoy, until further notice, the right of movement, residence and establishment without visas, in accordance with the organisation's protocols. Niger's embassy in Turkey says a visa is mandatory to enter Niger except for nationals of the member states of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) and of certain states with which Niger has agreements abolishing short-stay visas.

faq.question: Is yellow fever vaccination mandatory for Niger?
faq.answer: Yes. WHO's country list marks Niger as requiring proof of yellow fever vaccination from travellers aged 9 months and over arriving from any country, and the UK government says that to enter Niger you must have a certificate proving yellow fever vaccination.

faq.question: Can French citizens get a visa for Niger?
faq.answer: France's Foreign Ministry says entry requires obtaining a visa beforehand and that no visa is issued on arrival at the airport. Niger's Foreign Ministry says foreigners need a Nigerien visa unless an agreement exempts them, applied for in principle at a Nigerien diplomatic or consular post.

entryRequirements.travelInsurance.text: Medical facilities are poor, even in Niamey. Serious medical treatment would require evacuation to Europe. Make sure you have adequate travel health insurance and accessible funds

entryRequirements.customs.notes.0.text: Do not photograph military or government installations.
Photography of sensitive installations is prohibited. This includes:
Don’t photograph political or student demonstrations, or military personnel. Always seek permission before photographing a person.

countryFacts.payments.text: Niger is a cash-based society. Credit cards are rarely accepted even in hotels and restaurants visited by international clients. There are few ATMs.

countryFacts.safety.text: FCDO advises against all travel to Niger
This is due to the rise of reported terrorist and criminal kidnappings of foreign nationals which have taken place this year in Niger.
There is a very high threat of kidnapping throughout Niger, including Niamey.
The political situation remains unstable following the military coup in July 2023.
The Government of Niger will only allow foreign nationals to travel outside of Niamey if you get their permission and are escorted by Nigerien security and military forces.
There have been reports of gunfire around the Presidential Palace and Diori Hamani International airport early morning on 29 August.

countryFacts.driving.text: You must carry an International Driving Permit along your valid Canadian driver’s licence.
You can drive in Niger using a 1968 International Driving Permit (IDP) for up to 3 months. If you’re staying longer than 3 months, you will need to get a Nigerien licence.
